# PDF.js 6.5.438

Official Mozilla distribution from https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.5.438.tgz.

Apache-2.0; LICENSE and the standard font licenses accompany the deployed files. The legacy display and worker builds are the same pinned version. No document data is sent to a CDN. External CMaps and image WASM decoders are unused by these Swedish/English forms.
